title: live-SAFE-024 focuses a task box label the chooser does not render
what: live-SAFE-024 fills the shared task box before Start with focusField on `${ROOT} textarea[aria-label="Task for every seat"]`. The chooser labels that box "Task for all of them" (src/launch/ChooserPane.tsx:731) and each seat's own box "Seat N: opening prompt" (line 718); "Task for every seat" appears nowhere in src/. focusField therefore throws before the six-seat launch, so the proof's own subject (six real Claude agents starting with no folder-trust question) is never exercised.
expected: The shared task box the proof focuses carries the label the chooser renders ("Task for all of them"), or the proof types into the per-seat "Seat N: opening prompt" box, so the six seats can be started.

test.name: audit S2 > live-SAFE-024 label drift > [S2-F01] the task box it focuses is one the chooser renders

title: startProve never answers the session chooser, so every scenario proof times out
what: startProve adds the project by path and then waits 30 s for `section.pane[data-agent]`, but a new workspace opens the session chooser (`section.pane.chooser`), which starts no terminal until a seat's Terminal button and Start are pressed. startPlain solves exactly this at live-common.mjs:404-412 (pick TID.seatTerminal for every seat, then click TID.chooserStart); startProve never refers to the chooser at all. Every proof that goes through scenario() (live-SAFE-003, live-SAFE-004, live-SAFE-024, live-STAT-001, live-ROW-989, live-SESS-030, live-SUBAGENT-418, live-VIEW-025, live-VIEW-025-reproof, live-ESC-diag, live-flood) stops at that wait; a run of live-SAFE-024 against the real app ended with `ERROR Error: timed out after 30000 ms waiting for the first shell pane`.
expected: startProve picks Terminal for the seats and presses Start when the first pane is the session chooser, the way startPlain does, and only then waits for the Claude pane.

test.name: audit S2 > live-common startProve > [S2-F02] startProve answers the session chooser before it waits for a pane

title: Five active proofs still drive the editor and Explorer removed in fccac517
what: The code editor and its Explorer were deleted in fccac517: `.ex-row` survives only as orphan CSS (src/styles.css:122), no component mounts CodeMirror (no @codemirror/view anywhere in src/), and no component contains the control "Hide the explorer". live-edit-common's clickRow clicks `.ex-row` rows (line 32) and visText/cmOf read `.cm-content`; live-EDIT-001, live-EDIT-003, live-EDIT-012 and live-VIEW-107 use them, and live-EDIT-033 clicks `button[aria-label="Hide the explorer"]` (line 16). None of those five is marked `// retired:`, so each is an active proof that cannot get past its first step: clickRow returns false, and the wait for `.cm-content` or the focus call times out.
expected: An active proof that drives the editor or its Explorer either finds those components in src/ again or is retired with the repo's `// retired:` first line; no active proof waits on a screen the app no longer has.

test.name: audit S2 > retired editor and Explorer > [S2-F03] the editor surface the proofs drive is rendered by a component

title: openAllChanges clicks a Review changes item and opens a pane that were deleted
what: openAllChanges right-clicks the first project or worktree row and clicks a `.sb-menu` menuitem whose text is exactly "Review changes" (line 45), then waits 30 s for `section.pane.editor.all-changes`. The All Changes pane module was deleted (src/editor/AllChangesPane.tsx in a6195136 and fccac517), `.all-changes` appears nowhere in src/ except a comment in Pane.tsx, and src/projects/menu.ts offers no "Review changes" item at all (the removePaths test records that it went with the screens that showed it). live-EDIT-029 and live-GIT-038, both active, call it as their first step, so both time out before any check runs.
expected: The review surface the proofs open exists and the row menu still offers the item that opens it, or EDIT-029 and GIT-038 are retired and openAllChanges goes with them.

test.name: audit S2 > live-edit-common all changes > [S2-F04] the Review changes item it clicks is still offered by the row menu

title: live-checks b2 requires five palette screens the app no longer has
what: live-checks' b2 check asserts that the palette has rows starting "Show Floor", "Show Space", "Show Workspace Statuses", "Show Artifacts" and "Show Skills", then opens each row and looks for `section.floor`, `section.space`, `.ws-board`, `div.artifacts` and `section.skills`. Those screens were removed (a6195136 removed artifacts, skills and automations; the later wave A removals took the rest): none of the five labels and none of the five DOM classes exists anywhere in src/ or in src-tauri. b2 prints FAIL on the first row and can never pass, whatever the app does.
expected: b2 requires only palette rows and pages the app still renders, or the check is removed with the screens it tested.

test.name: audit S2 > live-checks b2 > [S2-F05] the palette rows b2 requires still exist

title: live-PROJ-077 reads a setup-policy select the composer no longer renders
what: run077 starts with `document.querySelector('select[aria-label="setup policy"]').value` (line 16) and later sets the same select. No select labelled "setup policy" exists in src/ any more, and the `.trust-prompt` element the control waits for (line 11) is gone too. The first line of run077 reads `.value` of null and throws, so neither the skip case nor the control that makes it meaningful ever runs; the proof is active, with no `// retired:` marker.
expected: The proof reads the setup policy from the control the composer renders today (and the trust question the app asks today), or it is retired; a missing control must not make the proof throw silently.

test.name: audit S2 > live-PROJ-077 setup policy > [S2-F06] the setup-policy select it reads is rendered by the composer
